boss_lasso_360.notes: Twelve authored front/side/back/side turn views. Review uses small hop offsets; synchronize jump/turn cadence to music in runtime.

helper_lasso_360.notes: One complete lasso turn. Authored poses, no HTML rotation. Hop timing may be tuned independently.

double_hammer_slam.notes: Two separate impacts for the two-word musical cue. Impact FX, camera shake and sound remain separate engine layers.

hammer_toss_helper_throw.notes: Boss+helper composite during pickup/carry. Hide standalone helper for attached frames; use separate airborne reel on release.

helper_airborne_tumble.notes: Eight authored tumbling views. Position/velocity/scale follow projectile trajectory; mouth layer on front-visible views only.

boss_speaker_sing.notes: Neck anchor bottom center; modular replacement head, not a floating duplicate. No baked text. Match body-view/head scale at integration.

boss_vocal_leap.notes: Vocal grille on torso; modular speaker head can provide mouth animation. Preserve airborne root offsets; captions/audio remain separate layers.

timing: Preview FPS and frame cues only. No song recording or verified timestamps supplied.
